 ORDER
This is an application for urgent hearing.
For the reason stated in the application, I.A No.7543 of 2025 is allowed.

This is first criminal appeal filed by the appellant under Section 14-A of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act in connection with FIR/Crime No.211/2024 registered at Police Station Shujalpur,
District Shajapur for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 376, 376(2)(n), of IPC, 1860 and Sections 5(l)/6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, and Sections 3(1)(w)(ii),
3(2)(v) of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989.

sentences.text: Appellant is in custody since 07.02.2025.

2. The prosecution story in brief is that the appellant enticed the complainant and had taken her to Ujjain, wherein he solemnized marriage with the prosecutrix and made physical relations, whereas the victim was minor.
3. Learned counsel for appellant submits that the appellant has not committed any offence.

He further submits that though the victim is minor, however, they both NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:14057 2 CRA-2123-2025 have already solemnized marriage and the victim is pregnant.
Investigation is over and charge sheet has been filed.
The conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.
Therefore, the appellant be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the complainant/victim, supported the application filed by the victim and submitted that appellant is husband of the victim, both of them have solemnized marriage.
Victim is pregnant and they want to continue the relationship, therefore, she prays for grant of bail to the appellant.
5. Government Advocate appearing on behalf of State opposed the appeal on the ground that the victim was minor at the time of the incident and therefore, her consent is of no meaning.
He prays for dismissal of appeal.

6. Considering the fact that the appellant is in custody since 07.02.2025, investigation is over,
charge sheet has been filed and conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the appeal is allowed.

7. It is directed that appellant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before said Court on all such dates as may be fixed by that Court in this regard during pendency of trial.
8. It is directed that the appellant shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS.
